projectDescription: A Windows desktop app that tracks living project state across meetings — recording, transcribing, and using AI to propose evidence-backed changes to requirements, decisions, tasks, risks, and open questions after every meeting.
keyFeatures: Botless meeting capture — records mic and system audio as separate streams, works with Zoom, Teams, Meet, Slack, Discord
Living project state board — typed items (requirements, decisions, tasks, risks, deadlines, open questions) with full version history
AI impact analysis — compares transcript against project state and proposes evidence-backed changes after each meeting
Hallucination guard — every proposed change must cite a verbatim transcript quote, validated in code
Approval workflow — accept, edit, or reject each proposal before writing a new project state version
Ask the project — Q&A grounded exclusively in the project's own state and meeting transcripts
Bring-your-own model — Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible server
Local offline speech-to-text — free English transcription with speaker labeling via sherpa-onnx, no upload required
Meeting auto-detection — watches Windows mic-usage registry, auto-stops when meeting app releases the mic
Share reports — export to Slack, WhatsApp, Markdown, or PDF with configurable evidence and transcript inclusion
Floating recording widget — always-on-top controls with live transcript line, mark moment, and stop
Global hotkeys — Ctrl+Shift+M to record, Ctrl+Shift+D to mark an important moment
publicApiSurface: MainEvents['meeting:changed'] — broadcast when a meeting's data changes
MainEvents['transcript:appended'] — broadcast when live transcript lines are added
MainEvents['meeting:detected'] — broadcast when a meeting app starts using the microphone
MainEvents['navigate:meeting'] — tells the renderer to open a specific meeting
